description: This Java source file defines the 'InteropQuoteRequestData' class which models a data structure for handling quote request data within the interoperation module of the Fineract project. It extends 'InteropRequestData' and includes properties like quote code, amount type, fees, and methods for validation, parsing, and normalization.

classes.name: InteropQuoteRequestData
classes.description: A data class representing a quote request in the interoperation module, including details such as quote code, amount type, fees, and methods for validation and normalization.

methods.name: getQuoteCode
methods.description: Returns the quote code associated with the quote request.

methods.name: getAmountType
methods.description: Returns the amount type used in the quote request.

methods.name: getFees
methods.description: Returns the fees associated with the quote request.

methods.name: normalizeAmounts
methods.description: Normalizes the amount fields using the specified currency, including fees if present.

methods.name: validateAndParse
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON object to create an 'InteropQuoteRequestData' instance if valid.
